product.title: Astroville Tunnel Tour & NASA Space Center Ticket/Transportation

description.text: Start with a guided walking tour of Houston's downtown tunnel system, then continue to Space Center Houston with admission and round-trip transport. The combo day links underground architecture with NASA campus free time at Rocket Park and major exhibits. Stops include Downtown Houston Tunnels, Bank of America Tower, Space Center Houston, Rocket Park. Local commentary and route logistics are handled so you can focus on Houston skyline views, bayou corridors, and neighborhood landmarks. Ideal for visitors basing in Houston who want a guided Space City experience without coordinating meeting points or attraction entrances on their own.
